versions.changelog:
- Updated the API base URL from http://10.168.1.162:5000 to http://10.168.1.162:8000 in documentation.
- No functional or code changes detected. Documentation only.

Major update: Expanded data coverage and documentation for macro-data-api.

- Added support for querying a wide range of new macroeconomic and financial datasets, including利率 (interest rates),商业银行资产负债表,国债,外汇储备,消费支出,投资,进出口等.
- SKILL.md now provides an extensive, categorized list of all supported data types and their respective query commands.
- Documentation includes detailed usage instructions and real command-line examples for each table.
- Original descriptions (货币供应量、汇率和美元指数) expanded to reflect new data types.
- Improved clarity and completeness of documentation for both Chinese and English users.

- Added display_name for improved skill identification.
- Expanded and clarified documentation with detailed usage instructions and endpoints.
- Updated metadata with a new emoji and explicit environment requirements.

- Added initial code file macro_api.py for API interaction.
- Enhanced documentation: updated SKILL.md with usage instructions, examples, and API details.
- No breaking changes; this version introduces the base implementation for querying macroeconomic data via API.

- Updated all example API endpoints to use the base address "http://10.168.1.162:5000" instead of "http://127.0.0.1:5000"
- Removed local server instructions for API base address to standardize usage
- No changes to API logic or functionality; documentation improvements only

macro-data-api 1.0.0 初始版本发布

- 支持通过 API 查询货币供应量（含季调、未季调）、主要汇率及美元指数
- 查询结果包括原始 JSON 和中文简要解释
- 提供标准化接口用法和查询规则，方便使用
- 输出示例帮助明确格式与解读要求
